rationale: John brings deep cloud infrastructure and AI/ML systems expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) paired with conviction that agentic AI requires cloud-native foundations, while Jake is building in the B2A (Business-to-Agent) space with a focus on low-level AI infrastructure tooling—a natural fit for exploring how enterprise infrastructure can power autonomous systems. John's background in systems architecture and developer community leadership complements Jake's founder mindset around infrastructure-level advantages, making them useful sounding boards on the infrastructure layer that both see as critical to the next wave of AI.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Jake Fitzgerald — you're both focused on the infrastructure foundations for agentic AI, from different angles (John on the ops/cloud side, Jake on the B2A tooling side).
